work_scope.capability: Read-only document translation metadata and rendering
work_scope.authority_owner: Existing source identity and projection selection; no mutation or terminal authority
work_scope.target_maturity: implemented with accurate metadata types and invalid-event checks
work_scope.required_evidence: Projection registry, event integration, inline selection and visible context tests; scoped typecheck
work_scope.explicit_non_goals: No model calls, translation execution, grant changes or installed acceptance

review: normalizeText already rejects every non-string at runtime; its parameter now accurately accepts unknown event metadata. Missing record metadata returns the existing snapshot immediately; previously it reached that same return through empty event/lane identifiers.
HelixLiveTranslationInlineUnitState now declares optional sessionControlKey, already emitted by both ready and error result paths. The emitted JavaScript of that module must remain byte-identical.

Five malformed or missing metadata cases preserve the current snapshot and do not notify subscribers before and after the change. The initial suite exposed an obsolete locale expectation, not a new runtime regression.

The older locale test treated an explicit docs_chunk projection as forbidden across account languages. Commit 09a37acb8 and the existing event-ingestion test explicitly support a requested document translation language differing from account locale. Updated the negative fixture to docs_hover; selected the positive cross-language document integration test unchanged. No language-selection code was changed.
Tests use synthetic translation receipts and local event targets. Projection, source identity and non-answer metadata remain distinct from task execution or terminal authority.

Expanded scoped compilation exposed 40 existing errors in selected fixtures. Metadata literals retain their union types; two unused role fixtures use the supported packet_composer role; four session fixtures include their required absent fields; eleven duplicate expected properties already supplied by the later spread are removed. No production contract was widened.

The two document translation entry fixtures also now provide required tool-evidence and false authority flags. They remain synthetic non-answer observations; production flags already followed this contract.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished and uninstalled. Tests do not execute translations, invoke a provider, or establish rendered installed tutorial behavior.
Remaining inline/visible-context status type mismatches are separate; this slice only corrects the registry metadata boundary and existing session key declaration.
